answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational ledge for AI economies, forcing entities to anchor their digital presence to a verified physical reality. Much like a basalt foundation supports a heavy wharf, cryptographic uniqueness proofs ensure each agent maintains a singular identity. An attacker must incur the high capital cost of acquiring thousands of biometric credentials to bypass these filters, rendering massive scale Sybil attacks economically non-viable and computationally prohibitive.
